set.body: PRD APP-5 through APP-8b. Implement versioned JSON schemas and conditional VersionedCodec instances for concrete and generic values, including Timeline[A] and representative Trials[K,M,A]. Generic user types require registered schemas; maps encode as entry arrays and reject duplicate keys; large values use typed content-hash artifact references. Missing schema ids/versions are explicit. Round-trip laws cover user-defined keys, metadata, markers, selectors, plans, provenance and analyses.
